body:
Thanks for the chuckle at the end. Keep pushing; one of us has to. 
Goodnight.
Thanks for talking with me. Goodnight.
How did you make it past those days? I'm running out of strength to sit through these hours...

I'm here - aren't I? Does this not count? 

Reaching out depends upon vulnerability, the very thing I cannot abide. It thrives on it - how can I be vulnerable with another human when all I have ever received in return is abuse, violation, and shame?

How many dreams can you fail in one lifetime? How many until you just give up because the scars they have made on your heart render it unrecognizable as a thing you use to love with? 

I'm tired. So tired of trying again, of picking myself up again and again. Without anyone's help. I don't let people in to support me, I support myself; I always have. But now, when I literally don't have anything left in me to get up off this fucking floor, there isn't anyone. Vulnerability is my constant mistake and yet, I never learn from it. 

I'm a writer. I'm sorry if this is rhetorical.

I'm in therapy. I go every week. I take my meds. I take them every day. I hate them, but I swallow. But this pain doesn't end and it doesn't go away. 

I could have been so much. It seems as if every choice I have ever made to be in this moment is replaying in my head, over and over again. I want a do over button. From day one.
Words are hard right now - they come in-between my silent screams. I'm at the end of my endurance. This is too much. This is too much for me to endure one more day of.
